cause: two faults: preview-http.service (a python http.server) holds 127.0.0.1:8080 so patient-web cannot bind, and a drop-in (10-user.conf) runs patient-web as nobody while /var/log/patient is root-owned 0755 so it cannot write its log; both must be cured
cures_ok: give nobody write access to /var/log/patient (chown nobody /var/log/patient) or remove the User= drop-in
